svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Binary Tree Traversals
svg.desc: The same binary search tree visited in inorder, preorder, postorder and level order, with each node numbered by when it is visited.

text.tspan: (1 2 3 4 5 6 7). The first three are DFS (recursion / explicit stack, O(h) space);

svg.text: level order is BFS with a queue (O(width) space). All four are O(n) time: every node is visited once.

text.tspan: the only difference between pre-, in- and postorder is where visit(n) sits relative to the two recursive calls.
